name: swamp-extension-checker
title: Deterministic check: Does this repository have a LICENSE file?

specification.purpose: Say whether a git repository has a licence file at its root, which file it is, and the licence's SPDX name when GitHub reports one.

inputs.name: repo
inputs.description: A GitHub repository as owner/name or a github.com URL. Empty means check path instead.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: A local directory; the git repository it is in is checked at its working-tree root. Used when repo is empty.

specification.output: One record: whether the repository has a licence file at its root, the file's path (or none), the licence's SPDX name when GitHub reports one, and where it was checked (the local working tree or the GitHub default branch). Outside a git repository it says so instead.
outOfScope: Judging whether the licence is suitable, valid or compatible with dependencies
Licence files below the root, licence headers in source files and package-manifest licence fields
Adding or changing a licence file
